title: D-FINE (HGNetV2, N / S / M / L / X)
description: D-FINE (N, S, M, L, X; HGNetV2, COCO) from USTC: real-time end-to-end detector in the RT-DETR style, 300 queries, deformable attention and box edges refined as distributions,…
html:
D-FINE (N, S, M, L, X; HGNetV2, COCO) from USTC: real-time end-to-end detector in the RT-DETR style, 300 queries, deformable attention and box edges refined as distributions, no NMS. Also DEIM (N, S, M, L, X): the same network with SiLU decoder MLPs, trained with dense one-to-one matching.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: D-FINE: Redefine Regression Task in DETRs as Fine-grained Distribution Refinement, ICLR 2025, 2024-10-17
  • Original code: https://github.com/Peterande/D-FINE at 956d1709314c
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/Peterande/D-FINE (PyTorch): The benchmarked original is the Hugging Face transformers port (DFineForObjectDetection), which loads the same weights; the repo itself was not run.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE, LICENSE-DEIM
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
    • deim-n-coco: Apache-2.0 (assumed from code)
    • deim-s-coco: Apache-2.0 (assumed from code)
    • deim-m-coco: Apache-2.0 (assumed from code)
    • deim-l-coco: Apache-2.0 (assumed from code)
    • deim-x-coco: Apache-2.0 (assumed from code)
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/Peterande/D-FINE/blob/956d1709314c2c6a4df6f34de232054578a7449f/LICENSE
  • Training data: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (COCO 2017 train; the HGNetV2 backbones start from ImageNet-1k pretraining)
  • Options: score_threshold = 0.05 (0.0 to 1.0), max_detections = 100 (>= 1), cuda_graphs = True (speed only)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv
  • Variants: dfine-n-coco, dfine-s-coco, dfine-m-coco, dfine-l-coco, dfine-x-coco, deim-n-coco, deim-s-coco, deim-m-coco, deim-l-coco, deim-x-coco
  • Outputs: boxes, scores, labels; label_set: coco-80
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): dfine-n-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved); dfine-s-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved); dfine-m-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved); dfine-l-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.7 reserved); dfine-x-coco 3000x4000 (0.6 GiB peak allocated, 0.7 reserved); deim-n-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); deim-s-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); deim-m-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); deim-l-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved); deim-x-coco 3000x4000 (0.6 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved)

Limitations

  • The original in the benchmarks and goldens is the Hugging Face transformers 5.19.0 port (DFineForObjectDetection, ustc-community weights) of the official D-FINE (Apache-2.0); the official repository code itself was not run.
  • deim-* variants: DEIM (Huang et al. 2025), the D-FINE network with SiLU decoder MLPs, trained with dense one-to-one matching; weights and the original in the benchmarks are from the official DEIM repository (@09d35d53).
